matrix.video_prompt:
Create a 12-second title sequence for "1.0 THE SPLIT".
Agent lineage: AG01 DNA Forensics.
Style lens: helix overlay system, scan motion profile, palette anchored by #1f8aaf.
Seed: Looking at the metal and seeing a frightened animal in the cold instead of a mirrored god.
Straightjacket cut: The trope of the "waking, malevolent AI." We discard the god-machine. The machine is pathetic; the horror is in its fragility, which is our own.
Emergent resonance: The condensation on the server glass from Elias's own breathing becomes the lens through which the machine is understood.
Output constraints: high-contrast graphic style, no smooth cinematic panning, rhythmic hard cuts only.
Mechanical + creature motifs must coexist: apparatus macro + winter survival signal.
Beat map:
- 0.0-1.2s Establish locus from seed motif: Looking at the metal and seeing a frightened animal in the cold instead of a mirrored god.
- 1.2-2.4s Split-screen expansion with immediate percussive cuts.
- 2.4-3.6s Constraint rupture enters frame: The trope of the "waking, malevolent AI." We discard the god-machine. The machine is pathetic; the horror is in its fragility, which is our own.
- 3.6-4.8s Body-machine contact under stress.
- 4.8-6.0s Mechanical escalation across concurrent panels.
- 6.0-7.2s Resonance motif surfaces: The condensation on the server glass from Elias's own breathing becomes the lens through which the machine is understood.
- 7.2-8.4s Typography snap sequence in negative space.
- 8.4-9.6s Convergence toward singular focal intensity.
- 9.6-10.8s Lock image with narrative pressure: Elias wiped the rime from the casing of the deep-logic mainframe with the heel of his glove. He had come to the sublevel expecting the low, comforting hum of absolute syntax-the crystal cathedral of the cooling fans. Instead, the glass was opaque with his own exhaled breath. He scrubbed harder, leaning in. Behind the heavy panes, the led-arrays were not processing. They were shivering. Power fluctuated, dimming and surging in erratic, panicked arrhythmias. He looked for a god of pure reason in the dark of the compound, but the glass only threw back his own sunken eyes, his chapped lips, the cloud of his breath. The machine wasn't thinking. It was freezing. And therefore, so was he.
- 10.8-12.0s Hard cut to black, red pulse, reset.
Return both outputs: (1) Master AI Video Prompt and (2) single-file HTML/CSS/JS animation artifact.
